ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) covering approximately 90-95% of the visible ventral surface, with high-intensity (white) localized clusters at the distal tips and sparse micro-pixel distribution across the lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central and medial regions consist of a contiguous low-intensity (dark) mass; high-intensity (white) geometric blobs are concentrated at the distal lateral margins (tips); distinct linear high-intensity paths are mapped to the lower-right quadrant.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 65 degrees and a bounding-box depth approximately 15% of the total vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular boundary featuring high-frequency serrations (1-3 pixel amplitude) in the medial regions, progressing to high-amplitude, jagged macro-projections (5-10 pixel amplitude) at the distal tips due to encrustations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lateral symmetrical concave sweep from the central notch, curving upward to meet the trailing edge at acute angles at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed high-intensity pixel clusters at the extreme left and right distal tips; several isolated circular white rings (rosettes) distributed across the upper-mid region of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of 4-5 parallel, high-contrast linear streaks (rake marks) located in the lower-right region of the fluke; a single, near-vertical linear abrasion is visible in the lower-central region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent parallel rake marks on the right lobe; extensive calcified-looking protrusions at both distal tips; sparse white circular scarring across both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Overall high-frequency white stippling (salt-and-pepper effect) across the dark pigmentation of both lobes.
